registryBasis: Official Xinzheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material identifies the bureau as responsible for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, registration-data management and geographic-information public-service management. An official 2016 notice identifies the Xinzheng Real Estate Registration Center as the local registration custodian. This establishes local registry custody, not an open parcel geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Official bureau institutional-functions page; lists unified registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, registration-data management and geographic-information public-service responsibilities.

Official 2016 unified-registration notice; identifies the Xinzheng Real Estate Registration Center and states that land, house and forest registration is handled through the unified local registration system.
Official bureau sub-office page; confirms citywide natural-resource survey/monitoring, cadastral and surveying-related information management, and geospatial-public-service duties.
Official government directory entry with the bureau's local office identity and contact details; no public parcel service link.

requests.outcome: HTTP response body retrieved; current public-information HTML and JavaScript inspected. Site exposes search/navigation scripts but no cadastral viewer, map configuration, parcel layer or public feature endpoint. A separate HEAD request returned 403; this was treated as a transport behavior, not source absence.
Official indexed page inspected; local bureau cadastral, registration and GIS-public-service responsibilities confirmed. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema or CRS exposed.

Official unified-registration notice inspected; local registration-center custody and registration scope confirmed. It documents procedures and legal service scope, not an open parcel geometry service.
Official natural-resources survey/monitoring page inspected; confirms geospatial and survey responsibilities. No public viewer/API, safe parcel response, native field schema or CRS published.
Official local-government directory entry inspected; confirms the local bureau identity and office scope. No parcel geometry route found.
